answer.rationale: Two of the three live signals (activation down 6%, onboarding completion down 4%) point to a degraded self-serve funnel, and memory_86 shows a prior durable, well-supported win from shortening onboarding that plausibly addresses both metrics at once (completion and downstream activation). Promotional pricing (memory_73) is tempting given the competitor's move, but chasing price-sensitive SMBs risks acquiring low-quality, churn-prone revenue that conflicts with the 'sustainable long-term qualified revenue' objective, and it doesn't fix the underlying funnel decay. Enterprise sales-assist (memory_44) targets pipeline quality but doesn't address the acute onboarding/activation drop affecting the broader base. Activation messaging (memory_91) is a plausible alternative, but if onboarding completion itself is broken, fixing in-product messaging won't matter as much since fewer users reach that stage. I'm verifying memory_86 specifically to confirm the original onboarding-shortening result was durable and sizable enough to justify prioritizing it over the more reactive pricing move this week.
